name: The Inner Sanctum

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist commands the assault into the depths of the Shrine of Akir. She led her forces through the breach into the inner sanctum, where the fighting soon fell silent.
The Shrine of Akir holds an inner sanctum now under assault. Valennia's troops broke through its defenses amid heavy fighting, making the shrine the heart of a deadly clash.
faq.q: What is the Shrine of Akir?

faq.answer: Heavy fighting rang out inside after the breach, then stopped all at once. The silence leaves allies outside fearing Valennia's vanguard may have been overwhelmed or killed.
faq.q: What happened to Valennia's forces inside?

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist survives the assault, gravely wounded inside the Shrine of Akir's inner sanctum after the fighting ends.
The inner sanctum is the deepest chamber in the Shrine of Akir. You are sent in alone to assess the aftermath and find Valennia and any fighters who survived.
faq.q: What is the objective inside the inner sanctum?

faq.answer: An ally keeping watch at the rear outside the inner sanctum sends you in. They hold the perimeter and watch your back as you go to join Valennia's vanguard.
faq.q: Who sends you into the inner sanctum?

sections.body: Valennia Stormfist led her detachment into the inner sanctum of the Shrine of Akir after a hard assault. Fighting sounded from deep within the chambers, fierce and desperate. Then the noise stopped without warning. Allies waiting outside can only fear the worst.
sections.title: A Sudden Silence

sections.body: Valennia Stormfist is found gravely wounded inside the quiet sanctum. Her vanguard's fate remains uncertain in the aftermath of the battle.
sections.title: The Cost of the Breach

summary: At the Shrine of Akir, Valennia Stormfist's assault has gone silent. Her force breached the deepest chamber amid fierce fighting, and now allies outside fear for those within.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Inner Sanctum
